action.objective: Verify d4e5 as the strongest winning continuation; confirm it is safe and improves the endgame before committing.
action.rationale: Broad depth-4 search gave d4e5 exact 932 (top candidate), above e4f4 926 and a5a6 860 (upper). Reserved verification is for d4e5. Need single-candidate verification at max depth 4 with safety check to convert it to commit-ready. d4e5 keeps the bishop active toward f6/g7, frees d4, and the PV f7g6 a5a6 g6h7 advances the passed a-pawn while the rook on e4 cuts the king off. No proven refutations or mate-in-one threats seen; verify before commit.
